categories.main_business_segments: Henan Shijia Photons Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: optical chips and devices, indoor optical cables, and cable polymer materials. Their product portfolio includes PLC optical splitter chips, AWG chips, VOA chips and modules, OSW chips, WDM devices and modules, optical fiber connectors and jumpers, FP laser chips, DFB laser chips, EML laser chips, indoor optical cables, and cable polymer materials. These products serve data communication, telecommunications, and sensing markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs an IDM (Integrated Device Manufacture) model covering chip design, wafer manufacturing, chip processing, packaging, and testing. Core technologies include planar lightwave circuit (PLC) technology, silicon photonics, dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM), and various laser chip technologies such as DFB, EML, and CW DFB lasers. They focus on high-end passive and active optical chips, high-density optical fiber connectors, and advanced polymer materials for cables. Production methods emphasize vertical integration, flexible production planning, and rapid response to market demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global data center operators, telecommunications equipment manufacturers, and sensing device producers. The company serves the data communication market driven by AI computing power demand, the telecommunications market undergoing upgrades to gigabit and 10-gigabit optical networks, and the sensing market including lidar and gas sensing applications. Their products are widely used in data centers, telecom networks, optical access networks, and industrial sensing applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales and manufacturing facilities. It also has growing overseas revenue, accounting for over 26% of total revenue, with key markets including the United States and Thailand, where it has subsidiaries. The company is expanding its international customer base and production footprint, including establishing a subsidiary in Thailand and plans for a Singapore subsidiary.
categories.supply_chain_position: Henan Shijia Photons operates mainly at the upstream and midstream segments of the optical communication supply chain. It designs and manufactures core optical chips and devices, produces optical fiber connectors and jumpers, and manufactures indoor optical cables and polymer materials. The company controls the full production process from chip design to packaging and module assembly, positioning itself as a vertically integrated IDM supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment focusing on high-end passive and active optical chips, including AWG, VOA, DFB, EML, and silicon photonics. It emphasizes innovation in 400G to 1.6T optical modules, high-density optical connectors, and advanced polymer materials for cables. Strategic R&D projects include high-power lasers for data centers and lidar, integrated photonic chips, and new cable technologies. The company also collaborates with leading universities and research institutes to accelerate technology development and commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical chips, devices, modules, optical cables, and polymer materials. The company mainly uses a direct sales model targeting large customers and system integrators. It also engages in customized product development and leverages its IDM capabilities to meet specific client requirements. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, with a focus on long-term contracts and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Henan Shijia Photons is a leading domestic player in China's optical chip and device industry, with strong capabilities in both passive and active optical components. It competes with international and domestic companies in the optical communication sector, particularly in mid-to-high-speed optical chips and modules. The company holds a significant market share in China for PLC optical splitters and AWG chips and is advancing in high-speed laser chips and silicon photonics. It is recognized for its comprehensive IDM model and growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.07 billion, a 42.4% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 64.93 million, a 236.57% increase. The company has shown strong growth driven by AI computing demand and data center market expansion. Total assets grew by 20.65% to RMB 1.78 billion, and equity attributable to shareholders increased by 5.63% to RMB 1.20 billion. R&D investment accounted for 9.63% of revenue, reflecting a high commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its vertically integrated IDM model, enabling rapid innovation and quality control across the entire optical chip and device production process. It offers a broad product portfolio covering both passive and active optical components, with advanced technologies such as silicon photonics and high-power lasers. Its products are recognized for high reliability, performance, and cost-effectiveness, supporting high-speed data transmission and emerging applications like AI data centers, 5G/6G networks, lidar, and gas sensing. The company also leverages strong R&D capabilities and strategic partnerships to maintain competitive advantages.
